<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Establishes, or gives up, this grid's ability to edit a catalog.

Giving it up only clears the flag. It deliberately does not undo the
unshallow or restore an https origin: both are properties of the local
clone rather than of the subscription, and re-truncating a history to
express "I would rather not edit this" would be a strange trade.
